# dsh-composer-plus

> Composer Plus: a community plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), DeepSeek's open-source agent harness. One install adds Codex-style quality-of-life features to the dsh desktop app and web UI, and iPhone access with the Tether app. npm package: `dsh-composer-plus`. MIT license. Unofficial.

Install in the dsh desktop app: Settings → Plugins → Add plugin → `dsh-composer-plus` → Enable now. Install in a web/CLI profile: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-composer-plus`, then restart dsh. Requires dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.2 and Node.js >= 22. Tested on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (desktop and web) and 0.2.1-rc.2 (web).

Features (each one can be switched off in Settings → Composer Plus):

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED FEATURES: edit docs/features.json, then run npm run build:readme -->
- Changes panel: right sidebar page with uncommitted / unstaged / staged / branch git changes and per-file diffs; read-only git.
- Feature ideas: Tinder-style cards on a right sidebar page; on a click, the chat's own model reads a short read-only summary of the project (top-level names, README/manifest heads, recent commits; no .env or key files, no symlink out of the project, no FIFO) and suggests up to 8 features as swipeable cards, written in dsh's UI language. Swipe right (✓ or →) starts a new chat in the same project in plan mode with the idea; ▶ Build now (or ↑) starts the new chat without plan mode, so the model makes the change at once (usual approvals); swipe left (✕ or ←) skips; ↓ (button or key) saves the idea in the project's Later list (kept per project folder under the dsh home, also after a restart; at most 50), where Plan starts the same plan-mode chat and Build now the chat without a plan, and both remove it from the list; Plan all (N) starts one plan-mode chat for every idea in the list and empties it; History keeps every suggested idea of the project (skipped, saved, started; at most 200) and the model never gets them again (Forget allows one again); the buttons and keys fly the card off like a swipe; Undo (Z) brings a card back. An optional focus topic (free text, at most 80 characters, or the fixed chips Performance, Accessibility, Tests, Security, Usability, Documentation) limits the suggestions to that topic; an empty focus sends the same request as before. Copy as checklist (Later list) copies the saved ideas as a Markdown checklist (`- [ ] Title — Summary`) with no network call. No model call before the click; nothing in the project is written.
- Content search: On by default; applies after a dsh restart. The dsh sidebar search (magnifier next to Workspaces, Cmd+K in the desktop app, Cmd+Alt+K in a browser) also finds chats by words in user and assistant messages and shows the matching text. It switches on dsh's built-in SQLite FTS5 index (off in shipped dsh) with an owner-only file at `$DSH_HOME/cache/composer-plus/session-search.db`; no own search code. Whole words only, no tool output; the first search after a start builds the index (about 15 s and about 1 GB peak Host memory for 250 chats).
- Turn rollback: Like OpenCode's undo or Claude Code's /rewind, a ↶ button on each of your messages takes that message and everything after it out of the chat and the model context (one hidden marker, the same mechanism as dsh's /compact; the log is never rewritten) and puts the message back in the composer to edit and resend. "Chat and files" also puts the project files back as they were before that message, bash changes too: the Host takes a git snapshot of the work tree before each message into a private store under `$DSH_HOME/cache/composer-plus/rollback/` (the repository's objects are read, never written; index, HEAD, refs, stash and config are untouched); only regular files inside the chat folder are written. Needs a git repository for files; the 50 newest snapshots per chat. When dsh-rewind-plugin is installed it owns rollback and Composer Plus shows no button.
- Delete chat: "Delete…" in a chat's sidebar menu (dsh itself only archives). The chat stops (dsh's own archive with stop) and its log folders, with its subagent chats, move to the macOS Trash (elsewhere `$DSH_HOME/trash`); the id stays archived, so a folder put back shows up under "Archived only" after a restart.
- Project name in the composer: the stats row under the composer (turns, tokens, cache hit) starts with the chat's project name (dsh's project title, else the folder name); the folder path is its tooltip; a click finds the chat in the sidebar (opens the sidebar, the project and Show more, scrolls to the chat, which blinks for 5 seconds).
- Input history: ↑ / ↓ in an empty composer recalls messages you sent.
- Shift+Tab plan mode: Shift+Tab adds or removes `/plan ` at the start of the draft, or leaves plan mode.
- Keep composer focus: after you send a `/` command or skill, the cursor goes back to the composer, unless a menu, a dialog or another field has the focus. (dsh makes the composer read-only while it resolves the command, and the browser removes the focus.)
- One-click Continue: after a stopped, failed or cut-off turn the Send button becomes ▶ and resumes without a visible chat message. Queued messages stay queued: ▶ continues only the stopped task, then the queue runs.
- Resume after restart: Off by default. Chats that were working when dsh quit or closed continue by themselves at the next start; a running `/goal` round goes on with the next goal round. Chats you stopped, finished or failed chats do not continue. dsh has no built-in setting for this.
- Queue drag-and-drop: reorder queued messages by dragging the ⠿ grip or with ↑ / ↓.
- Copy session link: right-click a chat to copy a `dsh-session:` link that attaches it to another chat as read-only context. dsh 0.2.1's own "Copy Session ID" copies only the plain id; this item comes right after it.
- Export chat as Markdown: right-click a chat (or its … menu) → Export as Markdown… → Copy to clipboard or Save .md file. The user's messages and the assistant's text replies, oldest first, with a title, the project name and the date; code blocks are kept (an open fence is closed); tool calls, thinking, hidden context and messages withdrawn by Turn rollback or dsh-rewind-plugin are left out (messages that /compact summarized stay); at most about 4 million characters. The Host route `GET /api/composer-plus.export?sessionId=` reads only the chat log.
- Copy project path: right-click a project in the sidebar → Copy path copies its full folder path.
- Project search in a new chat: the new chat project menu lists the projects A–Z and has a search box (type part of a name, Enter picks the first match); dsh's saved project order does not change.
- Next message prediction: On by default; switch it off in Settings. After a finished turn, the empty composer shows a guess of the user's next message in that chat (Tab accepts, Esc hides); the model is chosen in Settings from dsh's own model list, default = dsh's default model; one short model call per finished turn; Tether shows it above the composer.
- Complete while typing: Off by default; switch it on in Settings. While the user types, grey text after the cursor shows how the message may go on (Tab adds it, Esc hides it); it suggests only the user's own next words (never a reply to the user, no made-up error texts or names) and shows nothing when the message looks complete or the model is not sure; its own Model menu in Settings (default: Same as Next message prediction; the choice is kept by the Host in complete.json and a model must be one that dsh lists); one model call at each pause while typing (many more tokens); not for slash commands, chips or a cursor that is not at the end; Tether shows it above the field (tap adds it).
- Improve prompt: On by default (a model call only on a click). A magic wand button in the composer's tool row rewrites the typed draft as a clearer prompt for the agent (goal first, numbered steps for several parts, the check to run), with this chat (rolled-back messages left out), the project brief (README, AGENTS.md, manifests, latest commits), git's changed files and the paths whose names match the draft as context; keeps the draft's language and never invents names. The result replaces the draft in the composer and is not sent; Cmd/Ctrl+Z (one step) or the Undo improvement button brings the typed text back; typing during the call keeps the new text; Esc or a second click cancels; one call per chat at a time. Its own Model menu in Settings (default: the chat's model; kept by the Host in improve.json, a model must be one that dsh lists). Not for slash commands or a draft with a file chip; at most 8000 characters. Tether has the wand next to the field.
- Allow for this chat: In Auto Review approvals, allow one exact tool for the rest of one chat; revocable; saved across restarts.
- Project status: sidebar project rows show waiting / done / running (an unread finished chat shows its green dot also while another chat runs).
- Active projects first: a project moves to the top of the sidebar when one of its chats runs or needs you; the move is saved in dsh's project order.
- Recent projects filter: "Active in the last 2 hours" in the sidebar's view options shows only projects with a chat active in the last 2 hours; a finished chat that was not opened yet keeps its project shown.
- Collapse all projects: a sidebar header button, shown while a project is open, closes every open project.
- Order by status: "By status" in the sidebar's Order by puts finished, then running or waiting, then automated chats first in "In one list" (view only).
- Background notifications: OS notification and Dock badge when a chat finishes or really waits for an approval, a question or a plan review; click opens the chat.
- Application language: Switches the whole dsh interface to one of 11 extra languages: Türkçe, Español, Português (Brasil), Français, Deutsch, Русский, 日本語, 한국어, Bahasa Indonesia, Tiếng Việt, हिन्दी. Each pack has 3,143 texts: every UI text of dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2, the plugin's own texts and the dsh-rewind plugin.
- Mobile connect (iPhone): use dsh from the Tether iPhone app on the same Wi-Fi or over Tailscale. Switch it on in Settings → Composer Plus (off by default, it opens a network port on the Mac); a "Mobile connect" button at the bottom left shows the pairing QR code (a tether://pair link: the iPhone Camera opens it in Tether, which asks before it connects; the Mac page shows the request, a countdown and what happened). Pinned TLS, one-time pairing code approved on the Mac, hashed device tokens, RPC allowlist. The phone keeps any number of paired Macs and switches between them from a picker at the top; only the Mac on screen is connected. The iOS app source is in tether/ios.
- Automatic updates: at dsh start, installs the newest GitHub release (once it is on npm, as its exact npm tarball) through dsh's own plugin manager and notifies; dsh 0.2.1 loads it at once when no dsh settings change, otherwise restart dsh to load it. The first start that runs the installed version shows its GitHub release notes once in a closable "What's new" window (from the same update check, no extra network call).
<!-- END GENERATED FEATURES -->
